# [reference] Body lift hardware specifications

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Select metric or SAE bolts based on required body lift height, using spacers if needed. [t1483]

## Parts

- Metric Bolts: Available in Class 8.8, Grade 5, or higher grades like 10.9/Grade 8. [t1483]
- SAE Bolts: 7/16" diameter with coarse thread pattern. [t1483]

## Specifications

- **Metric bolt length for 2-inch lift (long)**: 160mm [t1483] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Metric bolt length for 2-inch lift (short)**: 80mm [t1483] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Metric bolt length for 2-inch lift (very long)**: 180mm [t1483] ([Unverified] single report)
- **SAE bolt length**: 6 inches [t1483] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- If using a shorter body lift than the bolts are designed for, insert spacers to allow bolts to tighten properly. [t1483]
- Consider Class 8.8 or Grade 5 finish if specific long metric lengths (160mm/180mm) go out of stock. [t1483]
